verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.

segments.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.

verses.text: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.

segments.text: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.

verses.text: Without speech or language, without a sound to be heard,

segments.text: Without speech or language, without a sound to be heard,

verses.text: their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens He has pitched a tent for the sun.

segments.text: their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens He has pitched a tent for the sun.

verses.text: Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course,

segments.text: Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course,

verses.text: it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.

segments.text: it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.

verses.text: The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.

segments.text: The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.

verses.text: The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.

segments.text: The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.

verses.text: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous.

segments.text: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous.

verses.text: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.

segments.text: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.

verses.text: By them indeed Your servant is warned; in keeping them is great reward.

segments.text: By them indeed Your servant is warned; in keeping them is great reward.

verses.text: Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.

segments.text: Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.

verses.text: Keep Your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.

segments.text: Keep Your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.

verses.text: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.

segments.text: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
